Nina: Snippet:
Invoice: INV-2026-0912
Line A: Usage - realtime-llm - $6,000
Line B: Promo LUMEQ2 -$1,200
Line C: Promo LUMEQ2 -$1,200
Total after credits: $3,600 (expected $4,800)
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0912 posted 2026-09-12T11:20:41Z. Promo tag LUMEQ2 applied twice by pricing-experiment service.
Priya: Looks like duplicate delivery from the experiment webhook. Options: (1) refund $1,200 to card, (2) create account credit and issue CN. Lumenix billing preference?
Eve (Lumenix): We prefer a direct refund for reconciliation, please include a CN showing the reversal and a brief apology line we can forward to our accounting team.
Carlos: Approved. Issue refund $1,200 and create credit note CN-2026-0973 marked "reversal - duplicate promo". Priya route to Payments and include apology.
Nina: Opening FIN-8712 for engineering to add dedupe-id to the experiment webhook. Creating reversing journal + CN.
billing-bot: Refund request CN-2026-0973 created; queued for payout. ETA 72 hours.
Nina: Refund processed and CN emailed to Lumenix. Closing FIN-8712 after eng confirms webhook dedupe fix. :white_check_mark:
